You can then clean up your audio with Enhance Audio and dynamic auto-ducking, automatically add captions, reframe footage for vertical and square formats with Auto Reframe, and lengthen clips with Generative Extend.
Premiere on desktop and mobile exports videos without watermarks and is licensed for commercial use.
Whether you’re a YouTuber, a digital marketer, or a creative pro, you likely know that shooting footage is the easy part.
Editing your raw footage into a video that looks and sounds good, and keeps people’s attention, is the heavy lift.
This is where the latest Beta version of Adobe Premiere steps up.

Named a PCMag Best of the Year product in 2025, Premiere has a suite of baked-in (and recently refreshed) AI tools that automate basic, time-consuming tasks—transcribing, refining, cutting silences, coloring, and captioning, among others—freeing you up to focus on your narrative.
Here’s how Premiere’s AI tools can supercharge your editing workflow from your desktop or phone, plus export commercial-grade content to your platform of choice.
After you import your footage and the dialogue is transcribed into text, remove or rearrange the text in the timeline until your video is where you want it.
Next, clean up your audio using Enhance Audio and use Ducking to ensure your voice doesn’t compete with background music or sound effects.

Use Adobe Firefly-powered tools to extend video clips and generate any missing background sounds where necessary, review your video, and then use the "YouTube 1080p Full HD" export preset to optimize your file for YouTube.
No matter which platform your video is for, Premiere’s AI-powered tools help your final product look polished, with less effort and time required from you.
For example, the Auto Reframe tool saves you loads of time, as it automatically adapts landscape video for different aspect ratios, such as vertical (9:16) or square (1:1).
The AI identifies your main subject and keeps them front and center, no matter the format, by adjusting the framing across the length of your video.
Generative Extend is another standout.

Powered by Firefly, it allows you to lengthen video clips at up to 4K resolution by up to two seconds and audio tracks up to 10 seconds, smoothing out any awkward gaps with your background music or overall flow.
Premiere is also an excellent choice for editing raw 4K footage for your next cinematic masterpiece or client-ready deliverables.
As long as your hardware can handle 4K editing, Premiere’s AI capabilities will help you create professional-grade content.
Premiere’s baked-in AI features are ideal for beginners, as they allow you to bypass tedious manual steps and quickly create a polished video that’s formatted for any platform.
Premiere’s tutorials are an excellent place to start.
For example, Text-Based Editing paired with intelligent audio-mixing accelerates trimming and fine-tuning.
The handy Auto Reframe tool takes the guesswork out of adapting your video for different platforms and aspect ratios.
And if your video-shooting chops aren’t up to par, Firefly-powered Generative Extend can fill short gaps in your video.
Considering how much Premiere can accelerate and upgrade your video-editing workflows, Premiere is a cost-effective investment for individuals and small teams.
Premiere on mobile is built for social and offers core editing features for free.
The iPhone and Android versions have slightly different toolkits, but everything you need to create video content is available at no cost on both.
And you can always uplevel your videos with Generative AI by purchasing Firefly generative credits, or with a paid Premiere plan, which includes mobile.
No matter which Premiere tier you choose, Premiere exports commercial-ready videos without watermarks.
